text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Mhfufufufufufu, now, now, now...!
Shall I quietly observe the divine figures of all
the Umamusume-chans from the shadows again today?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Digital, got a second?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Bwahwha!? O-O-O-Oguri-san!?
How may I be of service!?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Mm. I was thinking of doing some rather special training today.
I've been looking for someone to join me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"A little special"...!? W-What a
wonderful ring to it! I've absolutely
got to burn this into my memory—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"I wanted to practice on both dirt and turf.
So I was looking for a student who could handle both, but—"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I really want to ask Digital for this one.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, with THAT Digital-san!?
Ehehe, well now, that's—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
—Whaaaaaat?!?!
M-M-M-Me?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, did you not want to?
I thought you'd be absolutely perfect for it, Digital..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I-It's not that I hate it! Even if heaven and earth split in two, I'd never hate it, but... w-wait...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
T-This is bad...!
I-I'm starting to hyperventilate... *cough*...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... What's the matter, Digital?
Are you feeling unwell? Or don't tell me...
are you hungry?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Running alongside you in this state seems impossible.
Forgive me for calling out to you when you were unwell—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Oguri-san looks so downcast...!?
Is it... all because of me...!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
—Uwooooooh!!
Digitan Resurrection!!!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...I'll do it! Agnes Digital will gladly
take on the challenge!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hm? Are you feeling all right physically?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Eh, yes! Absolutely no problem!
If I caused an Umamusume to lose her smile,
I wouldn't be able to show my face in the otaku world ever again!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yours truly, Digi-tan!! Will take you on!!
With all my heart and soul!!" any

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'm not quite sure what that was about, but I'm glad you're feeling better.
Well then, I'll be heading to the gate first.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Seeing Oguri-san's running up close...
The warmth, the breathing, the overflowing emotions...
Even if the sheer concentration of her preciousness knocks me out—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
If I can become even a single cornerstone supporting Umamusume-chan...
then this Digi-tan doesn't need a tomorrow!!
